abuse_report_receipt.name: abuse_report_receipt
abuse_report_receipt.value: ("canvas_saas"."abuse_report"."status" = 'submitted' AND "canvas_saas"."abuse_report"."received_by" IS NULL AND "canvas_saas"."abuse_report"."received_at" IS NULL) OR ("canvas_saas"."abuse_report"."status" = 'received' AND "canvas_saas"."abuse_report"."received_by" IS NOT NULL AND "canvas_saas"."abuse_report"."received_at" IS NOT NULL)

cny_price_draft_cost_amount.name: cny_price_draft_cost_amount
cny_price_draft_cost_amount.value: "canvas_saas"."cny_price_draft"."cost_amount" IS NULL OR ("canvas_saas"."cny_price_draft"."cost_amount" >= 0 AND "canvas_saas"."cny_price_draft"."cost_amount"::text NOT IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity'))

generation_task_pricing_snapshot_pair.name: generation_task_pricing_snapshot_pair
generation_task_pricing_snapshot_pair.value: ("canvas_saas"."generation_task"."billing_unit_snapshot" IS NULL AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."credits_per_unit_snapshot" IS NULL) OR ("canvas_saas"."generation_task"."billing_unit_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."credits_per_unit_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)

generation_task_text_quote.name: generation_task_text_quote
generation_task_text_quote.value: "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."text_quote_snapshot" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("canvas_saas"."generation_task"."text_quote_snapshot") = 'object' AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."price_version" IS NOT NULL AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."quoted_units" IS NULL AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."billing_unit_snapshot" IS NULL AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."credits_per_unit_snapshot" IS NULL)

generation_task_video_quote.name: generation_task_video_quote
generation_task_video_quote.value: "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."video_quote_snapshot" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("canvas_saas"."generation_task"."video_quote_snapshot") = 'object' AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."text_quote_snapshot" IS NULL AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."price_version" IS NOT NULL AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."quoted_units" IS NOT NULL AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."billing_unit_snapshot" = 'request' AND "canvas_saas"."generation_task"."credits_per_unit_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)

generation_video_stage_counters.name: generation_video_stage_counters
generation_video_stage_counters.value: "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."revision" >= 0 AND "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."inspect_attempts" >= 0 AND "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."download_attempts" >= 0 AND ("canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."wake_revision" IS NULL OR "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."wake_revision" >= 0)

generation_video_stage_id.name: generation_video_stage_id
generation_video_stage_id.value: "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."provider_task_id" IS NULL OR (length("canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."provider_task_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."provider_task_id" NOT IN ('.', '..') AND "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."provider_task_id" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

generation_video_stage_bound_phase.name: generation_video_stage_bound_phase
generation_video_stage_bound_phase.value: "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."phase" NOT IN ('accepted', 'polling', 'completed', 'failed') OR "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."provider_task_id" IS NOT NULL

generation_video_stage_rejected.name: generation_video_stage_rejected
generation_video_stage_rejected.value: "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."phase" <> 'rejected' OR ("canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."create_attempt_token" IS NULL AND "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."create_started_at" IS NULL AND "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."provider_task_id" IS NULL)

generation_video_stage_duration.name: generation_video_stage_duration
generation_video_stage_duration.value: "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."duration_evidence" IS NULL OR COALESCE((jsonb_typeof("canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."duration_evidence") = 'object' AND (("canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."duration_evidence" = '{"status":"missing"}'::jsonb) OR ("canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."duration_evidence" = '{"status":"invalid"}'::jsonb) OR ("canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."duration_evidence" = jsonb_build_object('status', 'reported', 'rawSeconds', "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."duration_evidence"->>'rawSeconds') AND "canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."duration_evidence"->>'rawSeconds' ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)([.][0-9]+)?$' AND ("canvas_saas"."generation_video_stage"."duration_evidence"->>'rawSeconds')::numeric > 0))), false)

model_pricing_credits_positive.name: model_pricing_credits_positive
model_pricing_credits_positive.value: ("canvas_saas"."model_pricing"."billing_unit" IN ('text_tokens', 'image_specs', 'video_specs') AND "canvas_saas"."model_pricing"."credits_per_unit" IS NULL) OR ("canvas_saas"."model_pricing"."billing_unit" NOT IN ('text_tokens', 'image_specs', 'video_specs') AND "canvas_saas"."model_pricing"."credits_per_unit" IS NOT NULL AND "canvas_saas"."model_pricing"."credits_per_unit" > 0)

wallet_ledger_amounts_finite.name: wallet_ledger_amounts_finite
wallet_ledger_amounts_finite.value: "canvas_saas"."wallet_ledger"."delta_available_units" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric) AND "canvas_saas"."wallet_ledger"."delta_reserved_units" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric) AND "canvas_saas"."wallet_ledger"."available_units_after" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric) AND "canvas_saas"."wallet_ledger"."reserved_units_after" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)

wallet_reservation_amounts_finite.name: wallet_reservation_amounts_finite
wallet_reservation_amounts_finite.value: "canvas_saas"."wallet_reservation"."requested_units" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric) AND "canvas_saas"."wallet_reservation"."captured_units" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric) AND "canvas_saas"."wallet_reservation"."released_units" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)
